place.name: Acoma Pueblo
place.description: Acoma Pueblo ( AK-ə-mə, Western Keres: Áakʼu) is a Keres Indigenous American pueblo approximately 60 miles (97 km) west of Albuquerque, New Mexico, in the United States. Four communities make up the village of Acoma Pueblo: Sky City (Old Acoma), Acomita, Anzac, and McCartys.
